register_notes_applied.text: RESOLVED by C-6c. IMG-TEXT held two cells -- flux-2-pro+C_composite_textless_base and flux-2-pro+code_overlay -- with the SAME route_key ('flux-2-pro') and the SAME arm ('C_composite_textless_base'), resting on the same four trial identities with two different verdicts (1 of 4 eliminated versus 4 of 4). C-6c rules that the two are DIFFERENT route mechanisms: the model drawing the text (route identity flux-2-pro, text_mechanism model_draws_text) and code composing the text on a textless plate (route identity flux-2-pro+code_overlay, text_mechanism deterministic_text_composition). The map now carries distinct route_key values and a text_mechanism field on every cell, the recompute tool groups the two judgings apart, and a router keyed on (route_key, arm) gets one answer. The cell KEYS are unchanged so consumers keep their references.
